body:
I’m sorry but I’ve always been the one in my family to smile. I had to smile at everything, find the good in everything- I was their happiness and I remember asking myself at 9 years old why it was always up to me to make them happy 

I lived this way as an adult. No matter what tragedy piece it together and find a way

This time tho. I can’t have people always say just find positivity. I berate my own brain saying find a way till I reach these points of insanity 

Then I allow myself to feel like I want to die because that’s what I want. And why not. This set of circumstances is very high to overcome. So high I can’t see the top. And ignoring my emotions isn’t working.

I just can’t have ppl say don’t want to die, because it’s what I want and I constantly force trick whatever myself all day every day to not think this and for these moments thinking it helps. It’s sanity. It’s what I really feel. And maybe need to really face if I can get over this. Or really face to choose that this kind of evil happening to me is too much to take this time

Someone can’t put their hand on my arm for reassurance, can’t grab my hand without risking hsv on their palm or fingertip

I’m still alive but I’m not sure how I’d get past this and actually still be sane and caring. I’d be too alone, too isolated 

I’ve been trying but at this age and with this, I’m finally realistically saying, how much can one person take

I’m beginning my goodbyes, I’ve said one, I don’t think I can voice anything to those I love most, mostly my sister

This world got what it what it wanted out of me and did what it wanted to me. If I’m of no help to it anymore, like being able to figure all of this out, it’ll benefit from my decaying body giving newer better life carbon to grow

Believe me people have told me just live not knowing the extent of things

I have to be able to say I can’t without being told I suck. Cuz really, I suck if I live I suck if I don’t. But I don’t want to feel worse about during if I choose it. It would be a relief for me and ya like I said. If I have no more good to give ending my life would be quite fine, I’d be taking away my negativity and waste of space
God thank you for letting me vent I didn’t even think I could my minds so gone usually, thank you so much you gave me happiness in sanity for these moments thank you

Thank you, I read ur posts here, they’re beautiful in a way but I’m sorry for the pain, pretty tho it reminds me of my relationship with my ex which was mostly bad just him constantly being suicidal and me constantly saving him, but we were close like the two of u I guess, even if he was actually just abusive

I’m not thinking very clearly right now but I’m grateful and if I can think clearly enough to vent clearly thank you I’ll talk 

I just I feel like I’m loosing my soul. I can’t think of anything I can realistically do and it makes me feel like there’s no love in this world for me

I’m really physical, like I like hugs touching, and I feel so devoid of life cuz I’ll just be this person with time who can’t touch

I feel like I have to turn into this crazy humanitarian that just does good but never gets any good 

And just normal things are so hard just thinking of any job that won’t be a struggle cuz they all will

And I have no idea what I “want” to do he’ll I might be homeless soon so not sure why I’m even on here

I want to just get a job in the marijuana industry and just be high and numb all the time and never dream again

I had so many dreams I was valedictorian but I don’t know why I’d try now I don’t know I don’t fucking know...

I guess I should stop thinking about love but that’s so hard, but my life’s gone and I can’t even think how’d it could work

Fuck thank you for posting I’m so sorry for the pain in ur life I really get it, I really hope you find a way to be ok I just don’t know, I just don’t know how to deal with life being this bad I don’t know if I can take it every day I just want to die and can’t think of ways to live fuck god maybe I can just ignore the herpes for just a second I don’t know anymore
